title: TUI catalog browse and cite
lead: An overlay lists catalog records by kind (active, then retired), and cites or uncites a record on the selected item through `ops.catalog_cite` and `ops.catalog_uncite`.
findings_note: owner request, session 2026-10-14: bring the TUI up to date with recent CLI features
boundary: **Not in this slice:** adding, editing, retiring or moving catalog records from the TUI. Those stay CLI-only for now.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: The catalog (index schema 8) holds goals, non-goals, requirements, constraints, decisions and assumptions, and has no TUI surface. Citing a record while reading a slice is the natural moment, and today it needs `slicer catalog cite`.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/tui.py`: a `catalog` mode and binding. The list groups records by kind in editorial order, and Space toggles a cite on the selected item through `ops.catalog_cite` / `ops.catalog_uncite` (`src/slicer/ops.py:500`, `:519`), with `vcs.require_no_merge` first, as every other TUI write does.
- `docs/tui.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `tests/test_tui.py`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the mode and the toggling.
3. Update the docs and CHANGELOG.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - The affected tests, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes after `r`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s281`, branch `feature/s281-tui-catalog`. Commit only on the branch.
